status: Shared geometry for interactive design preview and native prototype widgets

controls.label: Wave
controls.tooltip: Choose a sine, signed squared sine, half sine, or squared half sine waveform.

controls.label: Ratio
controls.tooltip: Frequency ratio relative to the played note. Zero selects a half-frequency ratio.

controls.label: Detune
controls.tooltip: Small pitch offset for beating and harmonic color; these are detune codes, not cents.

controls.label: Level
controls.tooltip: Operator level. Turn up for more output. The modulator changes timbre; the carrier changes loudness.

controls.label: Feedback
controls.tooltip: Feed the modulator back into itself for brighter, rougher harmonics.

controls.label: Atk rate
controls.tooltip: Attack rate: higher values reach full level faster. Zero prevents the attack from rising.

controls.label: D1 rate
controls.tooltip: First decay rate: how fast the envelope falls toward the D1 level. Higher is faster; zero holds.

controls.label: D1 atten
controls.tooltip: First decay attenuation: higher values set a quieter target for the first decay stage.

controls.label: D2 rate
controls.tooltip: Second decay rate after the D1 target. Higher fades faster; zero holds the level.

controls.label: Rel rate
controls.tooltip: Release rate after note-off. Higher is faster; the Sustain switch selects the separate rear release rate.

controls.label: Wave
controls.tooltip: Choose a sine, signed squared sine, half sine, or squared half sine waveform.

controls.label: Ratio
controls.tooltip: Frequency ratio relative to the played note. Zero selects a half-frequency ratio.

controls.label: Detune
controls.tooltip: Small pitch offset for beating and harmonic color; these are detune codes, not cents.

controls.label: Level
controls.tooltip: Operator level. Turn up for more output. The modulator changes timbre; the carrier changes loudness.

controls.label: FM amount
controls.tooltip: Scale how strongly the modulator changes the carrier. More adds harmonic complexity.

controls.label: Atk rate
controls.tooltip: Attack rate: higher values reach full level faster. Zero prevents the attack from rising.

controls.label: D1 rate
controls.tooltip: First decay rate: how fast the envelope falls toward the D1 level. Higher is faster; zero holds.

controls.label: D1 atten
controls.tooltip: First decay attenuation: higher values set a quieter target for the first decay stage.

controls.label: D2 rate
controls.tooltip: Second decay rate after the D1 target. Higher fades faster; zero holds the level.

controls.label: Rel rate
controls.tooltip: Release rate after note-off. Higher is faster; the Sustain switch selects the separate rear release rate.

controls.label: LFO Hz
controls.tooltip: Pitch and amplitude modulation speed in hertz.

controls.label: Delay
controls.tooltip: Delay code before vibrato starts. The rear Delay scale multiplies it.

controls.label: Pitch mod
controls.tooltip: Pitch modulation depth multiplier. Enable Vibrato and choose a nonzero PM range on the rear.

controls.label: Amp mod
controls.tooltip: Amplitude modulation depth multiplier. Also requires rear AM range and operator AM enable.

controls.label: Velocity
controls.tooltip: How strongly note velocity changes loudness. Zero ignores velocity.

controls.label: Vibrato
controls.tooltip: Enable delayed pitch modulation. PM depth and the rear PM range set its strength.

controls.label: Sustain
controls.tooltip: Use each operator’s Sustain RR setting from the rear after note-off.

controls.label: Chorus
controls.tooltip: Chorus amount. Recorded mode scales the captured stereo-side character; Studio uses its creative delay blend.

controls.label: Rate Hz
controls.tooltip: Chorus motion speed in hertz.

controls.label: Depth ms
controls.tooltip: Chorus delay modulation depth in milliseconds.

controls.label: Width
controls.tooltip: Stereo width multiplier. Zero is mono; one preserves the reference width.

controls.label: Noise
controls.tooltip: Added noise amplitude before master volume. The rear Noise model chooses Circuit or White.

controls.label: Drive
controls.tooltip: Additional creative saturation. Zero leaves this extra drive stage off.

controls.label: Cutoff Hz
controls.tooltip: Output low-pass cutoff in hertz. Lower values soften the high end.

controls.label: Output
controls.tooltip: Master output gain. One is unity; zero mutes the instrument.

controls.label: 01 LKS low
controls.tooltip: Level scaling below the keyboard pivot. Larger codes reduce the lower notes more.

controls.label: 01 LKS high
controls.tooltip: Level scaling above the keyboard pivot. Larger codes reduce the upper notes more.

controls.label: 01 RKS
controls.tooltip: Keyboard rate scaling. Larger settings speed up envelopes on higher notes.

controls.label: 01 Sustain RR
controls.tooltip: Release rate used when Sustain is enabled. Higher values release faster.

controls.label: 01 AM enable
controls.tooltip: Allow the LFO to change this operator’s level. The rear AM range and front AM depth set the amount.

controls.label: 01 DT2 +600¢
controls.tooltip: Shift this operator up by 600 cents, independently of fine detune.

controls.label: 02 LKS low
controls.tooltip: Level scaling below the keyboard pivot. Larger codes reduce the lower notes more.

controls.label: 02 LKS high
controls.tooltip: Level scaling above the keyboard pivot. Larger codes reduce the upper notes more.

controls.label: 02 RKS
controls.tooltip: Keyboard rate scaling. Larger settings speed up envelopes on higher notes.

controls.label: 02 Sustain RR
controls.tooltip: Release rate used when Sustain is enabled. Higher values release faster.

controls.label: 02 AM enable
controls.tooltip: Allow the LFO to change this operator’s level. The rear AM range and front AM depth set the amount.

controls.label: 02 DT2 +600¢
controls.tooltip: Shift this operator up by 600 cents, independently of fine detune.

controls.label: PM range
controls.tooltip: Base pitch modulation range used with front PM depth and the Vibrato switch.

controls.label: AM range
controls.tooltip: Base amplitude modulation range used with front AM depth and each operator’s AM enable.

controls.label: Delay scale
controls.tooltip: Multiply the front vibrato delay. Zero starts modulation immediately.

controls.label: LFO shape
controls.tooltip: Select a sine or triangle modulation shape.

controls.label: Global LFO
controls.tooltip: Share a running LFO phase across notes instead of starting each note’s phase separately.

controls.label: Vel → FM
controls.tooltip: How strongly note velocity changes FM intensity.

controls.label: Bend range
controls.tooltip: Pitch-wheel range in semitones.

controls.label: Wheel → PM
controls.tooltip: Additional pitch modulation depth from the modulation wheel.

controls.label: Polyphony
controls.tooltip: Maximum simultaneous voices.

controls.label: Chorus type
controls.tooltip: Recorded follows the recording-derived stereo transfer; Studio is a creative chorus.

controls.label: Noise model
controls.tooltip: Circuit follows the sibling-circuit noise spectrum; White uses flat-spectrum noise.

controls.label: Circuit
controls.tooltip: Enable the modeled sibling analog output transfer.

controls.label: Clock offset
controls.tooltip: Fixed synthesis-clock offset in parts per million. Zero is nominal tuning.

controls.label: Drift peak
controls.tooltip: Peak modeled clock excursion in parts per million.

controls.label: Drift rate
controls.tooltip: Speed of modeled clock drift in hertz.

controls.label: Master tune
controls.tooltip: Overall tuning offset in cents.

controls.label: DC block
controls.tooltip: Remove DC from the output.

controls.label: Limiter
controls.tooltip: Enable output-level protection.

notes: 35 main sound/performance controls on the front; 30 advanced options and calibration controls on the rear.
Reason standard patch-name and patch-browse widgets are represented by browser selection for review only; all 100 factory patches use the PSS prefix.
Patch level stores raw TL attenuation; readout displays OFF at TL>=99 and 99-TL otherwise.
Envelope rates are raw rate codes; cyan and lavender envelope faces identify their operator.
